title.zh: 将南达沃省马利塔市镇皮纳尔帕兰描笼涯Pinal Palan小学的名称变更为Juanito Doromal，Sr.小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pinal Palan Elementary School in Barangay Pinalpalan, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Del Sur, Into Juanito Doromal, Sr. Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pinal Palan Elementary School in Barangay Pinalpalan, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Del Sur, Into Juanito Doromal, Sr. Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Pinal Palan tại Barangay Pinalpalan, Đô thị Malita, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur thành Trường Tiểu học Juanito Doromal, Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pinal Palan ในบารังไกย์ Pinalpalan เทศบาล Malita จังหวัด Davao Del Sur เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Juanito Doromal, Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Pinal Palan di Barangay Pinalpalan, Kotamadya Malita, Provinsi Davao Del Sur menjadi Sekolah Dasar Juanito Doromal, Sr.
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Pinal Palan di Barangay Pinalpalan, Perbandaran Malita, Wilayah Davao Del Sur kepada Sekolah Rendah Juanito Doromal, Sr.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1996/ra_8229_1996.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Pinalpalan Elementary School in Barangay Pinalpalan Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao del Sur, is changed to Juanito Doromal, Sr. Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon it approval.
